name: Mauna Lani Resort, Auberge Collection
positioning: Renovated oceanfront resort on the Kona-Kohala coast of Hawaii's Big Island, part of Auberge Collection and known as Mauna Lani, Auberge Collection
best_for: Travelers who want a quiet Kona-Kohala coast base and are happy to stay on property
Guests interested in Hawaiian culture, such as petroglyph visits and guided paddleboard tours

facts.text: The hotel is a 40-minute drive from Kona airport, on the Kona-Kohala coast.
Auberge Collection purchased the resort in May 2018 and invested more than $200 million in renovations before its reopening on January 15, 2020.
The resort was a hangout for Elvis Presley and his friends in the 1970s.
The open-air lobby has warm cedar detailing, a wooden outrigger in the center, mounted Hawaiian artifacts and murals by contemporary local artists.
The Francis Brown Club is a private club lounge spanning four oceanview spaces, offering daily breakfast, all-day culinary offerings and signature evening gatherings.
The Francis Brown Club spaces are the Lounge, Lanai, Library and Winnie's Pantry.
Club guests can take a guided stand-up paddleboard tour with Kainalu Ocean Sports along black sand beaches.
Club guests can explore ancient petroglyphs with the Living Culture team.
CanoeHouse serves fresh seafood and farm-to-table produce with Hawaiian and Japanese influences.
HaLani is a casual open-air restaurant serving breakfast, lunch and dinner by the pools.
Condé Nast Traveler lists Readers' Choice Awards for the resort from 2017 through 2026.
